messages:
maggie (product): Quick sync — we need one final pass on prod rollout guardrails for the new quantized models. I sketched a minimum checklist. Can folks ack gaps by EOD? TL;DR: SLA wording, pricing parity, monitoring dashboards, support oncall, rollback window.

kevin (eng): Ack. Two asks: 1) add per-tenant throughput caps & clear fallback to fp16 model, 2) ensure KV-cache warming step in rollout.

sahil (pm): For pricing parity: we propose a 6-week grace period where dedicated customers keep current rates + opt-in to quantized. Need commercial signoff.

olivia (support): Support rota for week 0: recommend 24/7 on-call (tier1) with escalations to infra. Can we get runbook link? Also need quick triage flow for 'generation quality regressions' :eyes:.

maggie (product): Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quantize-rollout (WIP) — please comment. I added triage flow + customer comms blurb.

kevin (eng): Config snippet for rollout policy — please review:
```yaml
rollout:
  - phase: canary
    percent: 5
    duration: 48h
  - phase: ramp
    percent: 50
    duration: 72h
  - phase: full
    percent: 100
    duration: 0
fallback:
  on_quality_drop: revert-to: fp16
  on_latency_violation: degrade-to: smaller-model
```

olivia (support): Two support items: 1) SLA-exemption form for early adopter customers, 2) messaging template for billing grace + AB test opt-in. I'll drop templates by COB.

sahil (pm): SLA wording proposal: 'Hosted routes: 99.5% monthly availability; p95 latency ≤ 120ms; p99 latency ≤ 600ms. Credits apply when monthly availability < 99.5%.' Need legal review on credit calc.

maggie (product): We also need monitoring delta: token-level cost per route, prompt regression alerts based on eval-set. @kevin can you add a streaming metric for KV cache hit-rate?

kevin (eng): Yep. I'll add `kv_cache.hit_rate` and `inference.latency.p99` with 5m rollups. Alert thresholds proposal: hit_rate < 60% -> warn; hit_rate < 45% -> page. Latency p99 > 700ms -> page.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @kevin for canary rollout at 2024-04-18T16:00Z — 5% traffic. CI passed. :rocket:

sahil (pm): Risk: billing reconciliation for cached vs realtime tokens. Ops needs a mapping: cached_tokens vs billed_tokens so reports line up. @olivia can we hold a 30m finance/finops sync?

olivia (support): I'll schedule the finops sync. Also propose a 'grace overage' policy: first 2 weeks free up to 10% overage for early adopters, then standard billing kicks in.

maggie (product): Action items summary: KEVIN -> implement metrics + fallback paths + KV-warming step. OLIVIA -> runbook + billing templates + finops sync. SAHIL -> SLA wording + commercial signoff. MAGGIE -> publish final checklist to Console and set shiproom. I'll ping legal for the credit wording. If no blockers, greenlight tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

kevin (eng): ack. I'll have the metrics PR and the fallback tests ready for review within the window.

olivia (support): acked. Templates incoming.

sahil (pm): acked. Will coordinate with commercial for the 6-week opt-in paperwork.

maggie (product): Thanks team — if anyone finds a missing item (eg: telemetry retention windows, per-route cost attribution, or customer escape hatch), drop into this thread. Otherwise I'll collate and ship the final checklist by 10:00am tomorrow.
